The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 21-62°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.82 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three FeO₆ octahedra and corners with two FeO₅ trigonal bipyramids.
